newsitem.title: JAPAN: Typhoon Violet set to hit central Japan on Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Violet set to hit central Japan on Sunday.

text.p: Typhoon Violet, packing maximum winds of 144 kph (90 mph), was expected to hit central Japan on Sunday, the Meteorological Agency said on Saturday.
As of 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT), Violet was located 1,150 km (719 miles) southwest of Tokyo, the agency said.
Violet, the 17th typhoon to hit Japan this year, was moving northeast at a speed of 20 kph (12.5 mph), it said.
The typhoon was likely to start striking the southern part of Izu Peninsula, a popular hot-spring resort, on Sunday morning before pounding areas along the Pacific coast near Tokyo, the agency said.
The agency predicted the typhoon would dump up to 30 cm (12 inches) of rain.
